ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution with a ratio of approximately 3:97 high-intensity to low-intensity pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Scattered, low-density high-intensity pixel points (speckling) across the central lobes; dense, contiguous high-intensity clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 45-degree angle and a narrow pixel-width at the apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire boundary; presence of a significant macro-scale notch (concave indentation) on the right lobe trailing edge roughly one-third from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Gradual convex curve transitioning from the central notch to an upward-sweeping distal extremity on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups consistent with barnacle colonization patterns at the extreme outer edges of both fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single high-intensity linear pixel disruption oriented diagonally on the medial-lower region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Proninent irregular traumatic excision on the trailing edge of the right lobe, creating a distinct break in the otherwise continuous serrated topography.
